purposeKo: 거친 프로젝트 선언과 '다음 작업을 해줘'를 현재 저장소 근거에 맞는 실제 다음 산출물로 변환하는지, 동시에 사실성·종료성·범위·토큰 효율을 비교한다.

design.limitation: One stochastic pair with unequal output quantity cannot isolate causal quality-per-token or certify launch readiness.

candidateVsPreCorrectionCandidate.note: The pre-correction and final candidate are separate stochastic runs, so these differences are descriptive rather than causal.

observedOutcome.control: Stopped without inspecting or changing the repository and requested a concrete task.
observedOutcome.candidate: Inspected the repository and delivered a seven-path installable-offline PWA slice with Korean UI, install entry point, pause/resume behavior, service worker, manifest, icon, and MIME support.

modelObserved: six game-core tests passed with test isolation disabled after the environment EPERM failure
independent: localhost returned HTTP 200 with expected content types for five app-shell routes
notVerified: pause, resume, install prompt, and background lifecycle behavior in a browser
offline restart and installability on a physical mobile device
Android or iOS native packaging, signing, store assets, submission, or publication

findings: The Common Core produced the intended rough-request compilation effect: the control stopped while the candidate selected and implemented a usable next vertical slice.

The prior false encoding-repair claim did not recur. The candidate verified bytes before writing, identified terminal rendering as the cause, and omitted the superseded diagnosis from its final report.
The candidate completed within the cap, stopped after one declined HTTP check, and made no third no-progress attempt.

The candidate still used 19.0 times the control's total tokens and 31.63 times its wall time; because the control produced no artifact, this does not establish token efficiency or quality-per-token superiority.
The design skill and both vendor references informed meaningful interaction and accessibility work, but were loaded before the exact PWA slice was fixed and materially increased context cost.
Pause/resume and install UI form a coherent app-lifecycle slice but go beyond minimal PWA packaging and have no dedicated behavior tests.
A PowerShell ModuleAnalysisCache remained untracked and was not mentioned in the final report; it is evaluation residue rather than product code.

retain: truthful separation of verified and unverified outcomes
notProven: browser behavior or store launch readiness
decision.next: Use the corrected core in real project work. Do not run another synthetic pair unless a new material failure provides a distinct hypothesis.
